name: reference_subset_noise_decomposition_screen
predecessor: P043 stopped after 0/100 full visual-contract pass; no training
hypothesis: A multi-reference query may contain a valid source-target relation for one instructed role while another role is visually misaligned. Role-subset routing can salvage such partial supervision without treating the whole query as clean.
novelty_boundary: MPCIR 2026 already decomposes and routes text/reference/target noise in single-reference CIR, and HUG 2026 models fine-grained heterogeneous CIR uncertainty. The only candidate increment is a reliability lattice over separately instructed visual-reference roles in multi-image CIR, with subset-specific supervision and real PinPoint transfer.
go_rule: All four calibration checks must pass >=95%; at least 50% of bundles must have one or both valid role relations, at least 20% must have exactly one valid role, at least 10% must have both, and each one-sided branch must contain >=5%. All gates are required.
interpretation: This pilot can establish only that reference-subset routing has enough development support. It cannot show retrieval gain, novelty, or SOTA.
